description: This file contains shell script functions and configurations for PPP protocols in OpenWRT, including setup, teardown, and protocol-specific configurations for ppp, pppoe, pppoa, and pptp.

methods.name: ppp_select_ipaddr
methods.description: Selects an IP address from a list of subnets based on subnet masks.

methods.name: ppp_exitcode_tostring
methods.description: Converts PPP exit codes to human-readable strings.

methods.name: ppp_generic_setup
methods.description: Sets up PPP connection with provided configuration parameters.

methods.name: ppp_generic_teardown
methods.description: Tears down PPP connection and handles errors.

methods.name: proto_ppp_setup
methods.description: Sets up PPP protocol with specific configuration.

methods.name: proto_pppoe_setup
methods.description: Sets up PPPoE protocol with specific configuration.

methods.name: proto_pppoa_setup
methods.description: Sets up PPPoA protocol with specific configuration.

methods.name: proto_pptp_setup
methods.description: Sets up PPTP protocol with specific configuration.
